## Highlights
### Fixed
- Turning off a Space’s lock in Settings now sticks after one Touch ID or password check, instead of the lock coming back. With iCloud sync, turning a lock on or off reaches your other devices too, even where the Space is locked, without unlocking it there first. If a lock can’t change, Crest says so at the top of the window. - Shift-clicking a tab in the sidebar selects every tab between the active tab and the one you clicked, instead of only adding that tab like Command-click.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
